building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: unary_union(polygon_area(building_footprints)); sum equals union (footprints do not overlap)
assumptions: Building footprints are concept proposals (design_proposal), not statutory permits.
Green space includes park corridor, protective strips.
Plazas are concept nodes; ratio is indicative.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls absent from public site package; proposal states only conceptual intensity guidance.

talent_density.reason: Official employment statistics absent; indicator declared per announcement 1.5(2)1, computable after data release.
